São Paulo, BR

Este é um Banco de Talentos de Professores para a Escola Eleva São Paulo. A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se juntando a nós como professor(a), sua missão principal será lecionar para nossos alunos, estimulando o desenvolvimento deles com cuidado, responsabilidade e entusiasmo!

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas da matéria alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de licenciatura na matéria da sua área ou de Pedagogia ou Normal se tiver interesse em posição de Regente para Infantil ou Fundamental 1.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

The core mandate of this role is to bring innovative digital investment products and solutions to market, leveraging a patented and innovative digital WealthTech/FinTech product - Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) - built with several years of academic research in mathematical optimization, probability theory and AI techniques at its core. As a Principal Research Scientist - AI and Optimization, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation, product research, and proof of concepts for our AI research and Goals Optimization Engine (GOE) product roadmap. You will be responsible for mentoring and guiding a team of highly motivated research scientists, creating intellectual property, and ensuring successful client deployments and product development.

Innovation, Product Research, Proof of Concepts, Pseudocode & Design (40%):

At Collective Hospitality, we are a global connector fostering bold, authentic experiences through a hybrid of communal and engaging stays, designed for the modern explorer. We are seeking a passionate, dynamic Sales Executive to join our team and help build lasting relationships with local accounts while driving revenue growth for the hotels we represent.

Role Overview:

The Regional Sales Leader – LATAM is responsible for driving strategic sales initiatives to boost top-line performance across the region. This includes expanding existing accounts, acquiring new business through local and international promotional activities, and maximizing revenue opportunities for hotel properties. The role also involves leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing sales team to meet and exceed set targets. The position requires close collaboration with the VP of Operations to ensure sales strategies are aligned with the operational needs of each market.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Identify and pursue new business opportunities to maximize revenue, including local corporate accounts, meetings & events, and group segments.
  2. Represent the brand at local and international trade shows, sales missions, and industry events.
  3. Actively source, qualify, and solicit new leads while reactivating past accounts.
  4. Manage and report monthly KPIs and team performance to the VP of Operations.
  5. Monitor team performance against booking goals; recommend and implement improvement strategies.
  6. Collaborate with Revenue Management to align sales strategies with forecasting and business priorities.
  7. Oversee and optimize the performance of the Groups and Reservations departments, ensuring timely responses, high conversion rates, and effective proposal quality.

  12. Maintain full knowledge of all locations, services, packages, and promotions offered by the properties.
  13. Adapt priorities as directed by the VP of Sales, VP of Operations, or evolving business needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

  1. Minimum of 8 years of experience in sales within the hospitality industry, preferably in regional or multi-property roles.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.


What you'll do

Viasat seeks an expert attorney to provide legal support for Viasat's business units via the in-house legal department in São Paulo, Brazil. This role will also involve collaboration with the business and legal teams from the United States, other Latin American countries, and Europe. We provide strategic support for satellite telecommunications operations. We ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, draft and review contracts, handle risk, and support business initiatives related to satellite communications, spectrum management, and international regulations.

By joining our legal team, you will gain hands-on experience in satellite telecommunications law, regulatory compliance, and contract negotiations. You will have the opportunity to work on real cases involving spectrum allocation, international agreements, and industry regulations. You'll also engage with various customers, including regulatory agencies, external legal firms, and business units, gaining exposure to the complexities of the satellite industry.


The day-to-day
  • Provide advice to all levels of Viasat in the areas of telecommunications transactions, regulation, administrative and litigation matters, and communicate legal concepts in a way that non-lawyers can understand.
  • Legal Research & Analysis: Conducting research on laws related to contracts, regulatory, corporate and taxes matters
  • Contract Review & Drafting: Assisting in the preparation and review of complex contracts, partnership and service agreements, NDAs, and compliance documents.
  • Regulatory Compliance Support: Monitoring changes in laws and preparing summaries or reports for the legal team;
  • Risk Assessment: Identifying potential legal risks in business operations and helping develop mitigation strategies.
  • Litigation: Lead litigation at all levels and supervise outside litigation counsel.
  • Meetings & Teamwork: Participating in meetings with commercial teams, engineers, specialists, and external legal counsels to support business objectives.

What you'll need
  • Law degree from a recognized and respected law school and admission to the Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).
  • Ability to speak and write (including contract drafting and editing) English at a professional level.
  • At least 7 years of legal experience with a respected law firm or company in the following areas (preferably in the telecommunications industry, but will consider experience in other regulated industries):
    • Commercial contracts (drafting, reviewing, and negotiation)
    • Corporate law (corporate formation, governance and maintenance)
    • Tax law (knowledge of tax planning and indirect taxes applicable to telecommunications services is a plus)
    • Litigation (external law firm management, preparation and review of strategic pleadings)
    • Consumer law (handling administrative and judicial claims)
    • Regulatory law (experience with ANATEL or regulated technology sectors is preferred)
  • Microsoft Office Proficiency – Experience using Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to conduct legal research using national and international sources.
  • Ability to assess legal risks, interpret regulations, and apply critical thinking to real-world cases.
  • Strong Written and Verbal Communication – Ability to clearly articulate legal concepts and draft well-structured documents.
  • Proactive Approach – Ability to take initiative, handle multiple tasks, and ensure accuracy in legal documents.
  • Ability to work at least 3 days per week in person at the Viasat office in São Paulo during business hours.

What will help you on the job
  • An interest in innovation, technology, and regulatory issues, especially in the telecommunication's area.
  • Spanish language ability.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management software.
  • Familiarity with additional areas of law such as labor and privacy.
  • Post graduate degree in public, regulatory, privacy, or intellectual property law.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring engineering managers who are passionate about operational systems, open source technologies and cutting-edge hardware to lead engineering teams to enable and optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x and POWER systems.
We partner with the world's leading silicon vendors to optimise Ubuntu on their latest platforms. We integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements in Ubuntu while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.
Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You will be expected to drive healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisations as well as lead your team to deliver high-quality design and code.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role. We have open positions in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform-oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC-V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Software Platform Engineering Manager - Ubuntu for Next-Gen Silicon role at Canonical

Job Overview

Canonical is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager passionate about operational systems, open source technologies, and cutting-edge hardware. You will lead engineering teams to optimize Ubuntu for the latest x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x, and POWER systems, partnering with silicon vendors to enhance platform performance and features.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead and develop a team of engineers from graduate to senior levels.
  2. Oversee project delivery and support customer engagements.
  3. Provide technical leadership on system architecture projects.
  4. Implement disciplined engineering practices.
  5. Maintain and optimize platform software stacks.
  6. Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation.
  7. Engage with internal teams and external communities to promote technical excellence.

Qualifications

  • Strong academic background in STEM or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency in C, C++, and Python.
  • Experience with Linux, kernel, and user space software.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or similar distributions.
  • Proven leadership in software engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with open source communities.
  • Knowledge of computer architecture (x86, ARM, RISC-V, s390x).
  • Understanding of build systems, cross-compilation, and virtualization.

Location

This is a globally remote role with open positions across all time zones.

What We Offer

  • Flexible remote work with in-person team sprints twice a year.
  • Learning and development budget of USD 2,000 annually.
  • Competitive compensation with annual reviews and bonuses.
  • Comprehensive benefits including leave policies and employee assistance programs.

About Canonical

Canonical is a leader in open source software, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud computing. We are a remote-first, diverse, and innovative company committed to excellence and inclusion.

Dialpad is the leading Ai-powered customer communications platform, transforming how businesses communicate with their customers. About The Team
Dialpad’s Sr. Product Manager, Omnichannel will lead our Omnichannel solution. In this role, you’ll combine innovation, interaction with customers, cross-functional collaboration with Design and Engineering to drive the roadmap, requirements and Go to Market of our Omnichannel CCaaS and UCaaS product offerings.
Dialpad’s Product Management team plays an essential role in the organization with a fast growing disruptive product. This team collaborates closely with all major stakeholders in the company, including Sales, Marketing, Design, Architects, Engineers, and Support to constantly improve the quality and disruptive innovation of our products.
Your role
As a Sr. Product Manager of Omnichannel, you’ll own the roadmap, requirement gathering, prioritization, and execution of our end to end Omnichannel solution for web chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Messaging, and Social Media channels. You’ll work closely with the other Ai, analytics, CCaaS and UCaaS product managers to accelerate Ai adoption, automation, and usage across Omnichannel customers and users.
This position reports to our Sr. Director, Product Management for the Omnichannel portfolio and has the opportunity to be based in our Buenos Aires office in Argentina (flexible hybrid setting).
What You’ll Do

  • Own the roadmap for the Omnichannel products.
  • Unify the experience across all channels for end users, customers, supervisors and administrators.
  • Drive AI automation and analysis for all channels and users experiences.
  • Work closely with Customers, Sales, Marketing, and Analysts to research and capture the latest requirements.
  • Write the requirements (PRD, Jira) to capture what engineering needs to deliver.
  • Partner with Design to come up with the best possible design for the product.
  • Prioritize the requirements based on customer needs, and portfolio strategy.
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to follow up on the implementation.
  • Run the weekly standup with the Engineering team, re-prioritize as needed.
  • Partner with Customers (via Customer Success Managers) to bring products to Beta, and capture early adopter feedback.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to launch the product.
  • Partner with Support to make sure the product can be successfully supported.
Skills You’ll Bring
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Business, Engineering).
  • Proven experience (8+ years) in product management experience, ideally focused on contact center technologies or customer experience platforms.
  • Experience with the latest Ai generative and agentic technologies (e.g. chatbots and virtual agents).
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise level business solutions.
    • Experience with Omnichannel contact centers.
    • Experience with all types of communications channels (webchat, whatsapp, sms, messaging, social media).
    • Experience with Omnichannel Analytics.
    • Experience with CRM and other common enterprise connected systems.
  • Expertise in software in a SaaS environment.
Benefits And Perks
Professional development
Dialpad offers reimbursement for expenses related to professional development, up to an annual limit per calendar year.
Culture
We’ve been named a Top Workplace seven times, and a big part of this is because of our collaborative culture that elevates our teammates, celebrates wins, and brings together passion and talent.
Compensation
Teamwork makes the dream work, and Dialpad offers competitive salaries because each and every Dialer participates in our success.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) at Dialpad
At Dialpad, we are passionate about Doing the Right Thing. This means we are committed to building a values-driven culture that celebrates identity, inclusion and belonging. As a global company, it’s our responsibility to come together to create a culture where all Dialers can Work Beautifully , Delight Our Users, and Innovate Continuously to bring our world-class product to life.
Every Voice Matters at Dialpad. We build community through our Employee Resource Groups, company-wide celebrations, service days, and a robust internal learning & development program focused on the success of our Dialers.
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and marginalized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Dialpad we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include major public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This role involves leading a regional team, supporting continuous improvement of open source software by resolving customer-reported defects across the software stack, from kernel to user space applications and IaaS platforms. Your primary responsibilities include supporting your team’s growth, technical leadership, influencing culture, and collaborating on strategy and execution.

  6. Set expectations with other teams, management, and external stakeholders.
  7. Promote modern software development practices.
  8. Foster a healthy, collaborative engineering culture aligned with company values.

  • Experience in software delivery using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar.
  • Passion for software development.
  • Leadership experience in complex problem resolution and bug fixes.
  • Experience with version control systems like git.
  • Proficiency with debugging tools such as gdb or crash.
  • Strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Experience with Linux, preferably Ubuntu.
  • Knowledge of Open Source and its business models.
  • People management experience in support organizations is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.

description:
Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager II, Search role at Google .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager, you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy, and help develop your team. Teams work across various domains such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, and user interface design.

Operating at scale and speed, our software engineers are just getting started — and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, oversee a large product budget, and deploy large-scale projects internationally.

In Google Search, we're reimagining how to search for information—any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, maintaining an accessible and useful experience for billions worldwide. Joining the Search team offers an opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities aligned with organizational goals.
  • Establish clear expectations with team members, providing regular feedback and coaching.
  • Develop and evolve the technical roadmap for your teams.
  • Design, guide, review system designs, and write code to solve complex problems.
  • Review code from engineers, ensuring best practices in style, accuracy, testability, and efficiency.

¿Estás buscando una empresa que trabaje en grandes proyectos de ingeniería en todo el mundo? ¿Quieres marcar la diferencia mejorando la vida diaria de las comunidades a nivel mundial? ¿Buscas unirte a un equipo inclusivo y diverso en el que realmente puedas confiar? ¡Has llegado al lugar correcto! Únete a nosotros para remodelar el futuro con AtkinsRéalis. AtkinsRéalis está dedicada a diseñar un futuro mejor para nuestro planeta y su gente. AtkinsRéalis es uno de los grupos de ingeniería nuclear del sector privado más grandes de Canadá. Hemos estado proporcionando una amplia gama de servicios a la industria nuclear en Canadá y en todo el mundo durante más de 60 años. Estamos orgullosos de ser los guardianes de la tecnología nuclear CANDU canadiense. AtkinsRéalis está buscando Ingenieros de Procesos para ser parte de nuestro equipo en el apoyo al diseño de nuevas plantas de energía nuclear y la operación y renovación de las plantas de energía nuclear CANDU existentes.

Ubicación – Buenos Aires, Argentina

Tu rol dentro del equipo:

  1. Proporcionar soluciones de diseño y evaluaciones para sistemas de procesos, estructuras y componentes nuevos, actualizados y modificados.
  2. Realizar diseño/análisis de sistemas hidráulicos y electromecánicos.
  3. Proporcionar orientación técnica y liderazgo a ingenieros de niveles inferiores y/o a otros empleados técnicos.
  4. Asegurar el cumplimiento del programa de calidad de la empresa.
  5. Preparar y/o revisar documentos de diseño para plantas de energía nuclear; por ejemplo, Cálculo de Diseño, Requisitos de Diseño, Evaluaciones, Especificaciones Técnicas, Dibujos, Lista de Materiales y Clasificación de Código del Sistema.
  6. Preparar y/o revisar Solicitudes de Cotización de Ingeniería y Evaluaciones Técnicas de Licitaciones.
  7. Apoyar a la Gestión de Ingeniería con actualizaciones oportunas sobre el progreso de la ingeniería.
  8. Realizar recorridos, asistir a visitas al sitio y reuniones según sea necesario.
  9. Asegurar que se cumplan los códigos, normas y requisitos regulatorios aplicables.
  10. Proporcionar apoyo para la preparación de propuestas de ingeniería.
  11. Interactuar con partes interesadas internas y externas según sea necesario.

¿Por qué elegir AtkinsRéalis como empleador? Porque ofrecemos:

  1. Un entorno emocionante donde el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida personal es importante.
  2. Una amplia gama de oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.
  3. Pago competitivo y beneficios flexibles.
  4. Un entorno de trabajo enfocado en la salud y la seguridad.

El candidato ideal:

  1. Título en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería Nuclear o Ciencias de la Ingeniería de una universidad acreditada.
  2. 10 + años de experiencia en diseño/análisis de sistemas de procesos, preferiblemente proporcionando soluciones de diseño para plantas de energía nuclear CANDU o mercados BWR/PWR.
  3. Experiencia realizando trabajos según los procedimientos y prácticas de plantas de energía nuclear y calificaciones para actividades de ingeniería de plantas de energía nuclear es una ventaja.
  4. Sólidos conocimientos técnicos de todos los aspectos que abarcan los procesos nucleares CANDU, análisis, equipos y control.
  5. Experiencia realizando evaluaciones de balance de calor y termohidráulicas.
  6. Experiencia en diseño y disposición de sistemas de procesos.
  7. Conocimiento de herramientas analíticas utilizadas para el diseño mecánico y de procesos; por ejemplo, ANSYS, Mathcad, Flomaster, NUCIRC, CATHENA o similar.
  8. Conocimiento práctico de/experiencia en el uso de Códigos y Normas nucleares, incluyendo CSA N285.0 y ASME Sección III.
  9. Conocimiento práctico de/experiencia con la norma CSA B51, los códigos ASME B31.1 y otras normas o guías regulatorias aplicables a plantas de energía nuclear relacionadas con componentes permanentes de la planta, equipos de límites de presión y/o sistemas de reactores.
  10. Demostrar buenas habilidades interpersonales y la capacidad de trabajar en un entorno de equipo multidisciplinario.
  11. La experiencia en el sitio en construcción o puesta en marcha de sistemas mecánicos de plantas para industrias nucleares u otras industrias pesadas es una ventaja.
  12. Capaz de obtener una Autorización de Seguridad y pasar verificaciones policiales y de antecedentes que se realicen.
  13. Debe tener excelentes habilidades de comunicación y redacción técnica en inglés.

¿Estás listo para este desafío? Aplica hoy y únete a nuestro equipo para ayudar a diseñar un mejor futuro para nuestro planeta y su gente. En AtkinsRéalis, buscamos contratar a personas con diversas características, antecedentes y perspectivas. Creemos firmemente que el talento de clase mundial no hace distinciones basadas en género, origen étnico o nacional, identidad y orientación sexual, edad, religión o discapacidad, sino que se enriquece a través de estas diferencias.

AtkinsRéalis se preocupa por tu privacidad. AtkinsRéalis y otras compañías subsidiarias o afiliadas de AtkinsRéalis (referidas en todo momento como “AtkinsRéalis”) están comprometidas con la protección de tu privacidad. Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad en nuestro sitio de Carreras para saber más sobre cómo recopilamos, usamos y transferimos tus Datos Personales.

Al enviar tu información personal a AtkinsRéalis, confirmas que has leído y aceptas nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.

Talent Acquisition Lead (Brazil, Peru or Ireland)

About DA

Delivery Associates (DA) is a global consultancy helping the public sector deliver lasting impact through effective implementation. With roots in Deliverology and over a decade of experience, we support leaders from strategy to execution. Our remote team works worldwide with governments and philanthropies to scale results.

We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion—believing empowered, diverse teams drive stronger partnerships and more equitable outcomes.

Description

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Talent Acquisition Lead to join our People team. This role is ideal for someone with some managerial experience, capable of leading a small team while delivering on core responsibilities within the Talent Acquisition function. The successful candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing their own workload alongside supporting the development and performance of others. They will serve as a Performance Manager to a small number of colleagues and play a key role in driving team collaboration and delivery.

While this is not a senior leadership role, we are looking for someone who has previously managed people and can confidently provide guidance, feedback, and support in a team setting. This role is fully remote, but the candidate should be based in Brazil, Peru or Ireland.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership and team support:

  • Coach and mentor team members, providing constructive feedback to enhance their skills and capabilities.
  • Set clear objectives for team members, regularly reviewing progress and performance metrics to drive professional growth.
  • Represent the TA team as part of the wider People Team.
  • Act as a bridge between the TA team and senior leadership, facilitating effective communication and collaboration.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing, and accountable team culture.

Requisition Ownership:

  • Manage a portfolio of open roles across multiple functions and regions.
  • Lead end-to-end recruitment, including job briefings, sourcing, candidate assessment, and offer processes.
  • Partner with hiring managers to advise on recruitment strategy, structured interviews, and role scoping.
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience throughout.

Communication, Partnering and Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to align on hiring needs and recruitment plans.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, offering clear guidance, timely updates, and pragmatic solutions.

Operational Input and process Improvements:

  • Identify operational challenges and areas for process improvement across the recruitment function.
  • Contribute to discussions and proposals to improve team efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Use data to monitor requisition progress, flag risks, and support quarterly reporting.
  • Comfortably handle reporting and data interpretation, using metrics to make informed decisions and drive improvements
  • Maintain accurate records in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) and support data-led decision-making.

Core Competencies

We work well with people who demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Execution – Manages requisitions from start to finish with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Communication & Partnering – Builds effective relationships with stakeholders and communicates clearly and professionally.
  • Responsibility & Autonomy – Works independently, takes ownership of tasks, and uses sound judgment to escalate when needed.
  • Team Contribution – Collaborates effectively, shares knowledge, and supports the success of the broader team.
  • People Development – Provides constructive feedback, supports the growth of direct reports, and contributes to a positive performance culture.

Mindsets

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect any one person to do all these things perfectly. Our teams are made up of people who are:

  • Adaptable : Able to thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Proactive: Anticipates needs, takes initiative without waiting for direction, and demonstrates a forward-thinking approach to tasks and challenges.
  • Initiative: Demonstrates a self-starting attitude, actively seeks opportunities to contribute, and pursues improvements without being prompted.
  • Resourceful: Effectively navigates constraints and finds practical solutions to deliver results, even in the absence of ideal conditions.
  • Detail-Oriented: Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness in all tasks, ensuring clarity, consistency, and high standards of quality.
  • Team-Oriented: Works collaboratively with colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to a supportive and effective team environment.
  • Accountable: Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and consistently delivers reliable outcomes.
  • Inclusive : Embrace all voices and backgrounds to enrich our work.

Required Skills/Experiences:

  • A minimum of 6 years experience as a recruiter for an internal team, ideally in a high volume environment
  • Proven experience in people leadership, coaching, and providing feedback as a team lead or senior individual contributor
  • A proactive, resourceful and agile mindset is essential for this role
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Proficiency in data interpretation and reporting
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for partnering with senior leadership
  • Comfortable setting objectives, reviewing progress, and enhancing team performance
  • Previous experience hiring for top-tier consulting firms is desirable but not essential
  • Experience using Greenhouse, Slack and Google Suite
  • Fluent written and spoken English

What we offer:

  • Impactful work : Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and work on transformative projects.
  • Excellent colleagues: We strive to be as talent-dense and diverse as possible, so we are always learning from each other.
  • Growth environment : Everyone’s career pathway is unique-be part of a growing organization committed to continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility : Remote working environment with opportunities for global collaboration.
  • Healthy compensation : Our colleagues enjoy a comprehensive benefits package for the effort they put in.
  • Travel opportunities : Travel may be required depending on project needs.

Our Values:

These values serve as an anchor, enabling us to stay true to who we are and what we stand for.

  • Passion : It is all about impact.
  • Excellence : Delivering to the highest standards.

title: Vice President of Research
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?
Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus, attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the University President

Job Title: Vice President of Research

Department: Office of Research

Job Summary: The Vice President of Research plays a critical leadership role in advancing the research agenda of AUIB. This position is responsible for providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of all research activities within the university. The Vice President of Research works closely with faculty, staff, and external partners to promote a culture of research excellence and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive research strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals.
  • Identify emerging research trends and opportunities and guide the university’s research priorities accordingly.
  • Foster a culture of research excellence, integrity, and collaboration across all academic departments and disciplines.

Administration:

  • Oversee the Research Office and all university research operations.
  • Develop university research themes and foster new research initiatives.
  • Delegate regulatory responsibility to appropriate university units.
  • Oversee all research centers, institutes, and appropriate shared or core research facilities.
  • Oversee research partnerships with industry, government, and partner institutions.
  • Represent the university at appropriate research initiatives/collaborations and programs.
  • Represent the university on the appropriate national and international research committees.
  • Communicate and report on the state of the research enterprise.
  • Develop and ensure the maintenance of policies and procedures and fiscal responsibilities for the Research Office and all pre- and post-grant award activities.
  • Ensure university membership in the appropriate professional research associations.
  • Oversee the outstanding faculty and student research awards.

Research Funding And Grants:

  • Identify and pursue external funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships to support research activities.
  • Provide guidance and support to faculty in the preparation and submission of research grant proposals.
  • Oversee the administration of research grants, ensuring compliance with funding agency requirements.

Research Conduct:

Human Research Participants:

  • Ensure the University’s human research participant protection program.
  • Ensure stakeholders and affiliates have adequate resources and appropriate oversight.
  • Receive and assess reports of non-compliance.
  • Place limitations or conditions on an investigator’s or research staff’s privilege to conduct human research.
  • Ensure that University officials cannot approve human research not by one of the Institution’s IRBs.
  • Disallow research approved by the Institution’s IRB or an external IRB.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of an ethical human research participants program.

Animal Subjects:

  • Execute a humane and ethical animal welfare program in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Communicate non-compliance to appropriate regulatory bodies.
  • Execute the education and training of personnel in support of humane animal care and use.
  • Establish a university animal care and use committee.

Research Safety and Integrity:

  • Support compliance of all government environmental, health, and safety regulations.
  • Ensure the education and training of personnel in safe research practices.
  • Promote a culture of research integrity.
  • Ensure secure and ethical data use, data confidentiality, and compliant data management, sharing, ownership, and retention practices.
  • Promote compliance for responsible and ethical conduct of research professional development and training requirements.

Patents and Inventions:

  • Promote and support a culture of innovation and entrepreneurship.
  • Oversee policies and procedures on royalties and royalty sharing.
  • Oversee the office of IP.

Research Funding:

  • Ensure high quality and high volume of research applications.
  • Oversee the grant application priorities and submissions.
  • Engage with the government and industry to establish partnerships for sponsored research.

Faculty Support And Development:

  • Collaborate with academic departments to recruit, retain, and support research-active faculty.
  • Promote faculty development in research, including mentoring, training, and facilitating interdisciplinary collaborations.
  • Recognize and reward outstanding research achievements among faculty.
  • Research Infrastructure and Resources:
  • Ensure the availability of state-of-the-art research facilities, equipment, and resources for faculty and students.
  • Manage and allocate research space and resources efficiently.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Partner Sales Director will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will own the strategy, the sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with the GSI and will animate many customer workshops, sales events, public presentations and executive engagements.

  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
  • Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar

  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other

  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description:
Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Sustaining Engineering role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Technical Project Manager - Telco / MVNO Integration

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

This is a key role in the Network Engineering and delivery team, responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of a range of projects including complex systems integrations across telecoms networks and IT systems in multiple geographical locations and technical environments. This will require working with both internal and external teams to understand business strategy, business requirements and the delivery of solutions according to business priorities and to time, cost and quality. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with project teams (including vendors) and programme managers to define & agree scope and deliver the design, build and transformation of aggressive parallel deliveries across telecoms networks and IT systems, covering all features of the project both business and technology related.
  • Be business' representative and act on their authority and behalf to ensure delivery of appropriate business outcomes.
  • Work across the business to ensure the right level of engagement from project teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment across all teams driving towards continuous integration rather than delivering individual work streams in parallel.
  • Manage regular and consistent project planning sessions, meetings, and retrospectives, ensuring adherence to existing Project management processes and controls.
  • Pro-actively manage risks, issues corrections and escalations to ensure delivery remains on track to time, cost and quality.
  • Ensure that all project dependencies are identified, communicated and proactively managed.
  • Manage project expenditure and value, ensuring focus on business benefit realisation.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Minimum of 5-8 years' experience in project management role experience, covering the end-to-end project life cycle, ideally with a Telecoms, IT service or consulting company.
  • A background in mobile telecoms or the wider Telco industry sector is essential.
  • Previous experience in large telecom projects in Mobile Network Operators or Mobile Virtual Network Operators.
  • A track record in the delivery of Telecom integration projects, with high complexity, with multiple third-party suppliers.
  • Strong vendor and stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Managing complex resources and multiple teams in a matrix structure.
  • Management and delivery of concurrent projects that vary in scale and complexity.
  • Driven, energetic, robust and able to work independently without supervision.
  • Must be proactive, hands-on and be able to work independently.
  • Commercially oriented and able to manage relationships at a senior level.
  • Demonstrable experience in project management methodologies.
  • English and Portuguese proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus.
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Mobile networks delivery projects, from the service provider or vendor side.
  • Previous experience with Telecom regulatory framework including, but not limited to, lawful interception.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
About QuintoAndar Group
We are Grupo QuintoAndar, the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America. We develop technologies and innovation to transform and boost the entire living experience.

The Grupo QuintoAndar was born to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors so that technology could become part of living. And through it, we simplify and debureaucratize the experience for those looking for a new home. That's how we became the most valuable proptech in Latin America, leading the real estate market in around six countries and more than 75 cities around the globe.

After conquering Brazil with a pioneering business model in the real estate rental and buying and selling market, we expanded into the international market by acquiring Grupo Navent, which holds the number 1 ranking in Mexico (Inmuebles24 full), Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) and Ecuador (Plusvalia) - among others. We offer an end-to-end ecosystem to make life easier for those looking to rent or buy a home, sell a property and unblock a transaction. Think zero paperwork or bureaucracy: everything happens on a single platform, with transparency and speed alongside close, humanized support.

We are currently valued at over US$5.1 billion and continue to grow 4x year on year, breaking records.

To make all this happen, we have more than 4,000 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and the best design practices to guarantee a perfect experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with intelligent financial products.   • Possibility of constant learning
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools on the market;
  • Working in an informal environment with great people who care about each other;
  • Always having new challenges and being encouraged to achieve results that have an impact, always with high quality;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.

Stages of the Selection Process

Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:

  • Application,
  • People Interview,
  • Tech Screening (coding or architecture),
  • Technical interview (coding and architecture),
  • Offer

Every Engineer responsibilities at QuintoAndar:

  • Develop independent services and platforms to enable our Product to evolve (e.g. parts of billing, visit scheduling, price optimization, self-service negotiation);
  • Create easy-to-understand, well-documented APIs.
  • Create scalable, maintainable and user-driven solutions. We use several different technologies. You don't need to know all these upfront, but you need to learn fast.
  • Deal effectively with legacy code when necessary.

Tech Lead Manager responsibilities at QuintoAndar

On top of being a great Developer we expect you to:

  • Be a reference for your team. Be a great leader and a great manager.
  • Be strong technically and able to jump in and code parts of the problems we're solving.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design and Data to define a winning strategy and execution for your organization.
  • Help the career development of your reports
  • Build a great team both recruiting great talent and helping them grow

You may apply if you:

  • Are fluent in at least one computer language and don't mind learning others.
  • Have already led other Software Engineers into a successful product or platform.
  • Have fluency in Portuguese and knowledge in English - we usually use English to write our code, documentation, tools, reference materials and eventually talk to partners and co-workers from other countries;

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have strong knowledge of computer theory, including optimization of algorithms and distributed systems.
  • Have already developed scalable client-server mobile applications.
  • Have already built winning Products or Platforms on successful companies.
  • Have some experience with AWS services;
  • Have some knowledge in Docker, modern CDs/CIs (Jenkins, Travis, Circle, Drone, ...);
  • Know how to test and tune scalability.

Important:

  • Our selection process starts with registration! If you really want to be part of our team, take care of this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and give feedback even to those who do not follow the process;
  • All communication is done by email, so stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br so our emails don't end up in spam.

Diversity & Inclusion at QuintoAndar

At QuintoAndar, we believe diversity of perspectives and experiences guarantee a differentiated work environment, based on respect and valuing differences. Feel free to declare the information on the registration form. If you are not comfortable answering them, just choose the option "I prefer not to respond". This information helps us create an increasingly inclusive environment and it is used only for this purpose, it is confidential, and it will not impact your performance throughout the hiring process.

Data Protection Policy

The data entered in the selection process form is confidential and stored in a secure environment. We take appropriate technical and administrative measures to protect your data.

title: Aircraft Painter
description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our aviation maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. As an Aircraft Painter, you will work on a variety of aircraft types, ensuring the external appearance and protective coating of the aircraft meet both aesthetic and regulatory standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions.

This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are protected from environmental elements and have a visually appealing and professional finish. If you have an eye for detail and a passion for precision work, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants.
  • Apply primers, base coats, and topcoats according to industry standards and manufacturer specifications.
  • Use spray painting equipment to ensure even and accurate application of paint to aircraft surfaces.
  • Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft.
  • Inspect painted surfaces for quality, ensuring proper thickness, gloss, and uniformity of color.
  • Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards.
  • Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order.
  • Comply with safety regulations, using appropriate protective gear and ensuring the workspace is safe and clean.
  • Record and document all work performed, including materials used and procedures followed.
  • Work with other maintenance team members to ensure the aircraft is ready for delivery on schedule.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental regulations regarding the use of chemicals and hazardous materials.
  • Assist in the development of painting schedules and timelines, ensuring that projects are completed on time.
Qualifications:
  • Proven experience as an Aircraft Painter or in a related role (e.g., automotive or industrial painting).
  • Familiarity with aircraft painting techniques, materials, and procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
  • Skilled in the use of spray guns, sanders, buffers, and other painting equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality finishes.
  • Knowledge of safety protocols related to handling hazardous chemicals and materials.
  • Physical stamina and dexterity to work in confined spaces or at heights.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate effectively with other technicians and engineers.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working with a variety of aircraft types (commercial, military, private jets, etc.).
  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and metal treatment processes.
  • Knowledge of environmentally safe painting products and techniques.
  • Ability to apply complex custom designs, logos, or branding.
  • Certification in aircraft painting or a relevant field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience).
  • Knowledge of relevant aviation regulatory standards (such as FAA or EASA guidelines) concerning painting and surface finishing.
  • Training in the safe handling of hazardous materials (e.g., OSHA, WHMIS certification).
